title: An Accurate Platform for Investigating TCP Performance in Wi-Fi Networks
authors: Shunji Aoyagi; Yuki Horie; Do Thi Thu Hien; Thanh Duc Ngo; Duy-Dinh Le; Kien Nguyen; Hiroo Sekiya
background: Wi-Fi端到端TCP性能需要结合链路与传输行为评估
problem: 构建低成本评估平台并检验一致性
method: 仿真与实网交叉检验；14种TCP CCA

results: 特定条件下平台趋势一致；不同CCA优势随条件变化
discussion: 作者未来工作：扩展到802.11n/ax等实网验证
project_questions: 后续以实际链路时序校准服务模型

title: Fine-grained QoS provisioning with micropayments in wireless networks
authors: Hideya Masaki; Kien Nguyen; Hiroo Sekiya
venue: Nonlinear Theory and Its Applications, IEICE
background: 细粒度服务需要资源保障

method: MPTCP内核、source routing、常规/backup模式
